vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope vBRIEF for progression and unlock systems

narratives.Overview: Implement the long-term progression loop: players begin with one otter kid, earn one bedtime reward only after all active otter kids finish for the night, and unlock new otter kids or outfits through a mix of completion rewards and a three-spins-per-hour prize system.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: The player starts with one otter kid and may unlock up to four kids for now. FR-2: The game grants three prize spins per hour. FR-3: Unlock rewards always prefer something new instead of duplicates. FR-4: Bedtime rewards are granted only after all active otter kids complete their nightly routines. FR-5: Future content additions join the unlock pool for existing saves without resetting progress. NFR-1: Reward feedback should feel encouraging but not overstimulating. NFR-2: Time-based spin refill logic must remain reliable across app restarts.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-5 and NFR-1 through NFR-2.
